agencies.name: Environmental Justice Ombudsperson
agencies.label: primary
agencies.purpose: The neutral party for EJ complaints against CDPHE.
agencies.engage: File a formal grievance via the EJ Grievance Process website.

agencies.name: EJ Advisory Board
agencies.purpose: Advises the state on EJ policy.
agencies.engage: Provide public comment at regular meetings to influence statewide strategy.

agencies.name: Air Quality Control Commission (AQCC)
agencies.purpose: Sets statewide air pollution regulations; relevant to cumulative air impacts.
agencies.engage: Testify at public rulemaking hearings.

agencies.name: Water Quality Control Commission (WQCC)
agencies.purpose: Sets water quality standards to protect drinking water.
agencies.engage: Provide comment at public rulemaking hearings.

agencies.name: Energy & Carbon Management Commission (ECMC)
agencies.label: primary
agencies.purpose: Regulates oil, gas, and geothermal sites; frequent EJ concerns.
agencies.engage: File a complaint or comment on permits via the ECMC website.

agencies.name: Public Utilities Commission (PUC)
agencies.label: primary
agencies.purpose: Regulates utilities including energy costs and power plant siting.
agencies.engage: Comment on utility cases at public hearings.

agencies.name: Division of Housing (DOLA)
agencies.label: primary
agencies.purpose: Addresses fair housing, healthy housing conditions, and mobile home park issues.
agencies.engage: Access landlord–tenant resources, mobile home park programs, and complaint forms on their website.

agencies.name: Department of Transportation (CDOT)
agencies.purpose: Manages highway projects which can create traffic noise and pollution.
agencies.engage: Comment on project plans through the public involvement portal.

agencies.name: Department of Public Health & Environment (CDPHE)
agencies.label: primary
agencies.purpose: Lead agency on health outcomes related to environmental factors.
agencies.engage: File a general environmental complaint for specific pollution events.

agencies.name: Department of Labor & Employment (CDLE)
agencies.label: primary
agencies.purpose: Enforces worker safety laws and wage protections.
agencies.engage: Submit concerns about workplace safety or wage theft via their website.

agencies.name: Department of Education (CDE)
agencies.purpose: Oversees school siting and healthy school environments.
agencies.engage: Address the State Board of Education at public meetings.

agencies.name: Board of County Commissioners (BCC)
agencies.label: localFirst
agencies.purpose: Final decisions on land use, budgets, and county policy that affect EJ.
agencies.engage: Speak at public hearings.

agencies.name: DEI Advisory Board
agencies.purpose: Forum to raise concerns about whether county policies serve all communities.
agencies.engage: Provide public comment at public meetings.

agencies.name: Planning Commission
agencies.label: localFirst
agencies.purpose: Reviews land-use proposals that shape where industrial and residential uses are sited.
agencies.engage: Testify at public meetings about specific development projects.

agencies.name: Dept. of Health & Environment (LCDHE)
agencies.label: localFirst
agencies.purpose: First stop for local environmental health issues (air/water/waste/noise).
agencies.engage: Contact the Environmental Health division with specific concerns.

agencies.name: Dept. of Natural Resources
agencies.purpose: Manages open spaces — relevant for equitable access to green space.
agencies.engage: Provide input on management plans via the website.

agencies.name: Poudre & Thompson School Districts
agencies.label: localFirst
agencies.purpose: Boards decide on siting, facilities, and resource equity.
agencies.engage: Speak at your district’s Board of Education meetings.

agencies.name: City Council
agencies.label: localFirst
agencies.purpose: City ordinances, zoning, and budgets — main venue for city issues.
agencies.engage: Provide public comment at City Council meetings.

agencies.name: Planning & Zoning Commission
agencies.label: localFirst
agencies.purpose: Decides how the city develops; affects who bears environmental burdens.
agencies.engage: Comment on development projects at public meetings.

agencies.name: Human Rights Commission
agencies.purpose: Addresses civil rights and discrimination dimensions of EJ.
agencies.engage: Provide public comment or file a complaint via the website.

agencies.name: Neighborhood Services
agencies.label: primary
agencies.purpose: Code enforcement for healthy housing (mold, pests, noise) and landlord–tenant disputes.
agencies.engage: Report a concern or request mediation through the website.

agencies.name: Transfort & FC Moves
agencies.purpose: Plans for equitable public transit and mitigates transport pollution and noise.
agencies.engage: Provide feedback on routes and projects via the FC Moves website.

agencies.name: Environmental Services
agencies.label: primary
agencies.purpose: City department for local air quality, waste, climate programs, and some noise issues.
agencies.engage: Contact the department with questions or concerns through the website.

agencies.name: Fort Collins Utilities
agencies.label: primary
agencies.purpose: Manages essential services; relevant for service delivery and utility burden.
agencies.engage: Contact customer service for service issues; address policy at City Council.
